name: NearbySearchRequest
description: Request body for a Nearby Search.

includedTypes.description: Place types to include in the search.

excludedTypes.description: Place types to exclude from the search.

maxResultCount.description: The maximum number of results to return (1-20).

languageCode.description: The language in which to return results.

regionCode.description: The region code used to format the response.

locationRestriction.description: The region to search, expressed as a circle.
